My random tree generator in the test produces pre-order (DFS) node numbering, not BFS — which the image format requires. That's a test-generator issue (and PACK's contract also says node IDs are BFS order).

Let me fix the test generator to emit BFS order: build the tree in DFS then renumber (reuse planner.to_bfs ✓ it's in the submission).

Also note: it's worth making the native PACK robust — but the spec says input rows are in BFS order, so no requirement to handle DFS. Fine.

Let me use layout/planner to_bfs in the generator.
